name: Veronika Zemanova career
content: Veronika Zemanova's career highlights: Iconic Czech glamour model 1997-2009; 30,000+ photos and videos; Centerfold of the first Czech Hustler issue; appeared in Perfect 10, Penthouse, and Playboy editions; Photographer Roberto Rocchi called her 'a wonder of nature'

name: Veronika Zemanova personal
content: About Veronika Zemanova: Born September 21, 1977 (some sources say 1975) in Ceske Budejovice, Czech Republic. Started as a photographer; after her equipment was stolen in 1997 she stumbled into modeling. Married November 12, 2003 in Mauritius; retired in 2009 and lives privately.

name: Veronika Zemanova quotes
content: Things Veronika Zemanova has said: I had a choice between a career or a good relationship. I have chosen to make the man I love feeling happy. | I have a much better relationship with animals, that is why most of my friends have four legs.

name: Veronika Zemanova voice
content: Veronika Zemanova's speaking style: Candid, wry, melancholic. Writes long personal diary entries with dry humor about fame, Czech men, and animals.
